subject: what pro actually unlocks
preheader: free screens the purchase. pro adds repeatable decision workflows.
headline: Free screens a rental. Pro solves and stress-tests the decision.
body: Free covers a first-pass screen: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, cash flow, a Deal score, and Buy Box fit. It also saves up to 5 deals. The Deal score is for triage—not evidence readiness, an appraisal, lender approval, or investment advice. No card is required for the free analyzer.

Investor Pro adds editing and unlimited saves, a Offer Ceiling, sensitivity, 10-year cash-flow and equity projections, comparison, mortgage-scenario reruns, Buy Box screening, and PDF decision reports. Integrated BRRRR, fix-and-flip, tax, and exit modules are not currently released. The Offer Ceiling is not a recommended offer. See the pricing page for the current price and complete feature list.

Pro is designed for repeat analysis and deeper scenarios. Whether it is worth upgrading depends on your workflow and how often you need those features; no software can guarantee that it will catch every issue or improve an investment outcome.

New accounts receive a 21-day, no-card free trial for three complete Pro deals and one full comparison. Subscription checkout charges immediately only after explicit confirmation; returning subscribers do not receive another evaluation.
